segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ חַטּאוֹת הַצִּבּוּר וְהַיָּחִיד – אֵלּוּ הֵן חַטְּאוֹת הַצִּבּוּר? שְׂעִירֵי רָאשֵׁי חֳדָשִׁים וְשֶׁל מוֹעֲדוֹת. שְׁחִיטָתָן בַּצָּפוֹן, וְקִיבּוּל דָּמָן בִּכְלִי שָׁרֵת בַּצָּפוֹן, וְדָמָן טָעוּן אַרְבַּע מַתָּנוֹת עַל אַרְבַּע קְרָנוֹת. כֵּיצַד?
segments.en: «MISHNA:» These are the halakhot of «the communal and the individual sin offerings. These are the communal sin offerings: Goats of the New Moon and of the Festivals. Their slaughter» is «in the north» of the Temple courtyard, «and» the «collection of their blood in a service vessel» is «in the north, and their blood requires four placements on the four corners of the altar. How» did the priest do so?

segments.he: עָלָה בַּכֶּבֶשׁ וּפָנָה לַסּוֹבֵב, וּבָא לוֹ לְקֶרֶן דְּרוֹמִית מִזְרָחִית, מִזְרָחִית צְפוֹנִית, צְפוֹנִית מַעֲרָבִית, מַעֲרָבִית דְּרוֹמִית. שְׁיָרֵי הַדָּם הָיָה שׁוֹפֵךְ עַל יְסוֹד דְּרוֹמִית, וְנֶאֱכָלִין לִפְנִים מִן הַקְּלָעִים לְזִכְרֵי כְהוּנָּה בְּכׇל מַאֲכָל, לְיוֹם וָלַיְלָה עַד חֲצוֹת.
segments.en: «He ascended the ramp» of the altar «and turned» right «to the surrounding ledge» and he continued east, «and he came to the southeast corner» and sprinkled the blood of the sin offering there and then to the «northeast» corner and sprinkled the blood there, and then to the «northwest» corner and sprinkled the blood there, and the «southwest» corner, where he performed the fourth sprinkling and descended from the altar. «He would pour the remainder of the blood on the southern base» of the altar. «And» the meat portions of the offering «are eaten within the curtains,» i.e., in the Temple courtyard, «by the males of the priesthood.» And they are eaten prepared «in any» form of «food» preparation, «on» the «day» the offering is sacrificed «and» during the «night» that follows, «until midnight.»

moves.summary: Communal sin offerings: slaughter and collection in the north, four placements on four corners
Order of corners, remainder on the southern base, eaten by male priests until midnight

positions.claim: slaughter and collection in the north; four placements starting southeast; remainder on the southern base; eaten within the curtains by male priests until midnight
